lens: SOUND: narration pacing and pronunciation risk, music fit and development, mix loudness and ducking, cue transitions, silences
ledger: No earlier reviews in qa/reviews/ and no film.json stages.fixes ledger, so there were no prior fixes to check. This is the first gate review.
evidence: mix/loudness.json: master -16 LUFS I, TP -1.7, LRA 4.8; duck 3.32 dB (ratio 3, threshold -26 dBFS); every line at least 10 dB over the music (lowest L0312 10.4); room-tone floor -58 LUFS; 13 cues, all gainDb -4, each fade at least 1.6 s after its last strike.

narration: 182 lines, 2741 words, 113 wpm overall and 150 wpm while speaking, 75% of the film has speech, median gap between lines 1.6 s; line LUFS after leveling has mean -22.1 and sd 1.16, outliers L0312 -27.0, L0105 and L0501a -25.6.

stt.json: L0301 and L0810 'Cheng Lou' heard as 'Cheng Lu' (homophone); L0918 'Cheng' heard as 'Chung'; L0303 'Its tutorial' heard as 'It's tutorial'; L0210 'learn the' heard as 'learned'. voice.json: the human listening checks for Kleene, Cheng Lou, TOML and RegExp are still pending.

Low-band (40-250 Hz) envelope of the cue renders, measured with ffmpeg astats in 0.2 s windows: m03 swings a median 4.4 dB per 2 s window with a 1.6 s period (autocorrelation r 0.70); m09 swings 4.7 dB with a 2.2 s period (r 0.70); m12 swings 4.7 dB with a 2.4 s period. The repaired m02 swings 1.1 dB. This is the contrabass-loop beating that the m01 and m02 notes diagnose and fix, but m03, m09 and m12 still hold gm_contrabass for 35-41 s.

issues.problem: The ch08 low point (981-1061 s) has the barest bed in the film: a gm_contrabass G1 held 39.2 s, then F1 for 41.2 s, then G1 for 26.5 s. It beats audibly, with a 40-250 Hz swing of a median 4.7 dB (max 7) per 2 s at a steady 2.2 s period, right in the narrator's fundamental range under L0801-L0808a. The spectrogram also shows the throb in the 330-400 Hz band from 0 to 80 s cue-local.
issues.fix: Replace the long gm_contrabass and gm_pad_bowed holds with the re-bowed tuba pedal from m01 and m02 (the bows() helper on two alternating lanes, a fresh bow every 1-2 bars, short bow changes, lpf about 280-400). Re-render, then confirm the 40-250 Hz swing inside each hold is 1.5 dB or less.

issues.problem: The pedal under ch03 is gm_contrabass C2 held 0-35.4 s and 40.3-75.3 s cue-local (190-265 s). It wows a median 4.4 dB at a 1.6 s period, the same 1.57 s artefact that the m02 note says was fixed there. The m03 note even concedes that the analyser 'reads the low pedal's slow beating as a later onset'.
issues.fix: Swap in the same re-bowed tuba bows() pedal used in m02, keeping the C to G moves on the flips and strikes. Re-render, check the low-band swing is 1.5 dB or less, then re-measure lastStrike.

issues.problem: The film's central worked example is read 'If a is more than four, ten', with only 0.06 s between 'four' (ends 4.74+0.30) and 'ten' (starts 5.10 line-local). It is heard as 'more than four-ten', and STT transcribes it the same way. The code on screen helps, but the ear does not get the ternary.
issues.fix: Give L0108 a spoken field that forces the break, for example 'If a is more than four... the answer is ten. If not, twelve.' (or an explicit <break time="0.4s"/>). Re-narrate it, confirm a gap of at least 0.35 s between 'four' and 'ten', and re-anchor the 'check' beat in ch01-s06 if the line length changes.

issues.problem: 'That guess was ours.' is the first payoff of the film's guess device, yet it is the quietest line in the film: -30 LUFS raw, -27 after the capped 3 dB ride, momentary -16 against a -11.9 median. It also has the smallest margin over the music of any line (10.4 dB), and it is spoken 0.7 s after m03's drawer strike at 270.00.
issues.fix: Re-narrate with fuller presence (same plain delivery, not a whisper) and target -22 to -24 LUFS raw. Alternatively, let the mixer ride L0312 up to +6 dB as a named exception. Pair this with the m03 strike move below.

issues.problem: After the last relay clack (1433.98) the cue fades out by 1437.0. The final 18.4 s (end card, credits and sources cards, out to black at 1455.2) has only the -58 LUFS room-tone floor, which is effectively silence. 'The film ends hanging on D' only works if the D is actually heard hanging. Instead the audience gets dead air that reads as a dropout.
issues.fix: Keep the clack as the last onset, but let one very soft low D (re-bowed tuba or cello D2-D3, lpf 400, about -36 LUFS) sustain from 1434.5 through the cards and fade over the last 4 s into 'black' (1455.2). Extend m13's end to 1455.4 and move lastStrike or the fade checks to match.

issues.problem: The ch03-s06 strike (pencil plus the low drawer thump on 'strike3' 270.00) decays straight into the quiet L0312 (starting 270.70). m06 handles its twin, L0505 'That guess was ours too.', by holding the drawer until the breath after 'too', so the two payoffs are treated inconsistently.
issues.fix: As in m06 ch05-s03, keep only a ghost pencil scratch on 'strike3' and move the drawer and the V to I bass fall to the breath after 'ours' (about 272.2-272.8, before L0313 at 272.86). Leave nothing heavy under 'That guess was ours.'

issues.problem: The opening question 'Where did those weights come from?' is rushed: 2.0 s at about 190 wpm with no internal pause. It is quiet (-28.6 LUFS raw, momentary -14.2) and the answers in L0106 follow after only 0.50 s, so the question that drives the whole film never gets room to land.
issues.fix: Re-take with a spoken field that slows it (for example 'Where did those weights... come from?') and open the gap before L0106 to at least 1.2 s inside ch01-s05. Re-anchor the tag beats if L0106 moves.

issues.problem: 'Its tutorial: ...' is heard as 'It's tutorial', and STT transcribes it that way, which sounds like a grammatical slip at the start of the definition line.
issues.fix: Change the spoken form to 'The tutorial says: ...' or 'Its tutorial puts it this way: ...' and re-narrate. Subtitles can keep the written text.

issues.problem: The author's name is pronounced inconsistently. STT hears 'Chung' in L0918 but 'Cheng' in L0719 and L0903, and 'Cheng Lu' in L0301 and L0810. The human listening check for Cheng Lou is still pending.
issues.fix: Listen to L0301, L0719, L0810, L0903 and L0918 back to back, pick the read that occurs most often, re-take the outliers with the same seed and settings, then run film:voice signoff --term 'Cheng Lou'.

issues.problem: The tag 'learn the weights, don't write them' (line-local 2.14-2.56, 'learn' running into 'the') transcribes as 'learned the weights', which turns the imperative tag into a past-tense statement. The same tag returns in L1206, where it reads correctly.
issues.fix: Re-narrate with a spoken field 'a younger tag. Learn the weights. Don't write them.' so the imperative is clear, and confirm by STT.

issues.problem: The gm_contrabass F1 held 12.95 s under JSON's verdict (1315-1328 s) beats with a median 4.7 dB low-band swing at a 2.4 s period, the same artefact as m03 and m09 but shorter.
issues.fix: Re-bow it with the tuba bows() lanes, or cut the contrabass and let the F-major string colour plus the cello carry the bass.

issues.problem: The note itself admits that the last tuba re-bow swells at 191.08, inside the 190.2-191.4 crossfade into m03's entry, so a bass bloom rises while the next cue fades in.
issues.fix: End the final bow by about 189.6 (release into the fade) so the m02 to m03 join is a clean decay over m03's low C. Re-measure lastStrike.

issues.problem: The macro-dynamics are flat. All 13 cues render within 2.5 LU of each other (-24.4 to -26.9 LUFS), every cue uses gainDb -4, no swell regions are applied, and the master LRA is 4.8. As a result the October blaze (m10), the film's only driving pulse, and the final wave (m13, 1385-1393) play at the same level as the winterBlue low point (m09).
issues.fix: Set gainDb per cue (for example m10 -3, m13 -3.5, m09 and m11 -5) and add swell regions in the speech-free gaps for the wave (1384.2-1389) and the m09 climb (1058.9-1070), held under the swells ceiling. Target a master LRA of about 6-7 with every line still at least 10 dB over the music.

issues.problem: The line-level ride is capped at 3 dB (maxLevelingDb), which leaves more than ten lines over 1.5 dB under target (lineLevels: L0312 -2.73, L0501a -1.99, L0421 -1.92, L0305 -1.91, L0425 -1.89, L0404 -1.82 ...). The level spread is mostly harmless, but it falls on short payoff lines.
issues.fix: Raise maxLevelingDb to 5 for lines measuring below -26 LUFS raw, or re-take those lines. Re-check linePeaks so that none ends up more than 2 dB over the median.

issues.problem: voice.json still has four pronunciation sign-offs pending: Kleene ('Clay-nee' respelling, L0204/L0624/L0908), Cheng Lou (L0301 and others), TOML (L1107, read as written after 'Tommel' failed STT) and RegExp ('Reg Exp', L0912/L0915/L0917/L0920). Also, L0702 stretches 'unfreezing' to 0.91 s at the head of the README quote, which may be a drawl artefact.
issues.fix: Have a human listen to the listed clips and record each result with film:voice signoff. Re-take any that fail, and re-take L0702 if 'unfreezing' sounds dragged.

best_moments: The score is literally a select: M1's upper and lower lines are both scheduled in every cue, a 1/0 gain gate picks which one is heard, and gate 0.5 gives 'the musical eleven' (B over A). The device is scored live in ch01-s06 (gate 1 on 'five' 65.43, 0 on 'three' 66.83, 0.5 on 'half' 70.02, and the 11-tile clack at 71.28 as the only percussive hit). It returns with the same voicing in m04 ch04-s06, m11 and m13.
m06 ch05-s03 holds the drawer until the breath after 'too' (546.22), so 'That guess was ours too.' plays over nothing heavy. The score gives way to a quiet line exactly as it should.

The cue joins are musical as well as clean: all 12 changes sit in speech-free gaps, and m12's unresolved low D becomes m13's entry pedal on the same D. The film then ends hanging on V with no final chord anywhere, mirroring its open questions.

The mix is technically clean: -16.0 LUFS I, TP -1.7 dBTP, a light calibrated 3.3 dB duck, every line at least 10 dB over the music in the voice band, a -58 LUFS room-tone floor with no dead digital silence, and the 'machines clack, never chime' palette (woodblock, paper noise, taiko drawers) held across all 13 cues.

The 'who tied it on / who doubted it / how long it held' refrain is scored as the detent figure (tie, flip, the strike left unplayed), so the bar hangs on V whenever a belief still holds. This is a real leitmotif system, not wallpaper.
